WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    a.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf ELSE 0 END) as group_sum
  FROM appearances a
  INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(group_sum AS FLOAT)) as avg_sum
  FROM grouped_data
  WHERE group_sum IS NOT NULL AND group_sum != 0
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gd.group_sum,
    oa.avg_sum
  FROM grouped_data gd
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE gd.group_sum IS NOT NULL AND gd.group_sum > oa.avg_sum
)
SELECT 
  SUM(group_sum) as total_sum,
  AVG(CAST(group_sum - avg_sum AS FLOAT)) as avg_difference
FROM filtered_groups
